armyRules.name: Strike and Withdraw
armyRules.flavor: The Legion hits the line, breaks it and is gone before the counter-blow.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule that wins a Combat may make a free Disengage move of up to 3" at the end of the Assault phase.
drawbacks: From the second consecutive Battle Turn that a Unit with this Special Rule remains Locked in Combat, its Models subtract 1 from their Weapon Skill Characteristic.
armyRules.condition: from the second consecutive turn Locked in Combat

armyRules.name: Horizon-Eaters
armyRules.flavor: Swift riders are hard to pin down and badly suited to standing guard.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule that moved 6" or more during its last Movement phase has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule against Shooting Attacks made from more than 12" away.
drawbacks: Enemy Shooting Attacks that target a Unit with this Special Rule that moved less than 6" during its last Movement phase add 1 to the result of their Hit Tests until it next moves.

armyRules.name: Honour of the Hunt
armyRules.flavor: A White Scars Character leads from the front and is shamed by hanging back.
benefits: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic on a Battle Turn in which its Unit makes a Charge.
drawbacks: If a Model with this Special Rule has neither made a Charge nor taken part in a Challenge by the end of the third Battle Turn, it subtracts 1 from its Initiative Characteristic until it does.

armyRules.name: The Khagan's Hunt
armyRules.flavor: When the Khan rides out, the Legion rides with him, and the hunt does not wait for the slow.
benefits: While Jaghatai Khan is on the battlefield, friendly White Scars Units within 12" of him add 1 to their Charge Rolls and to the distance they Rush.
drawbacks: If Jaghatai Khan is removed as a casualty, every friendly White Scars Unit subtracts 1 from its Charge Rolls for the rest of the battle.

wargear.name: Horsetail standard
wargear.summary: A tall pole hung with the manes of a hundred fallen rivals, which the unit follows as a banner and a challenge.
wargear.text: Every Model in a Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Horsetail standard has the Loosed at the Gallop Special Rule.

wargear.name: Stormcaller's totem
wargear.summary: A bone and feather fetish, empty of any power until a Stormseer decides otherwise.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Stormcaller's totem adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic when it is the target of a Psychic Check or Psychic Power.

wargear.name: Thunder-drum
wargear.summary: A hide drum whose roll carries a mile and tells the enemy the riders are coming.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Thunder-drum has the Rolling Thunder Special Rule.

wargear.name: Falcon-feather cloak
wargear.summary: A cloak of grey and white pinions that moves with the wind rather than against it.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Falcon-feather cloak has the Wind-Cloaked Special Rule.

wargear.name: Oath-braid
wargear.summary: A braid of knotted horsehair, each knot a vow made to the Khan.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with an Oath-braid has the Sworn Knots Special Rule.

wargear.name: Null-wind charm
wargear.summary: A strip of lacquered bone carved with a Stormseer's ward against the Warp.
wargear.text: A Unit that includes a Model equipped with a Null-wind charm has the Null-Wind Ward Special Rule.

wargear.name: Dust-curtain dispensers
wargear.summary: Canisters of powdered ceramite scattered behind the vehicle as it runs.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Dust-curtain dispensers has the Dust Cloud Special Rule.

wargear.name: Hunting horn
wargear.summary: A curved horn whose note calls the next wave of riders in from the flank.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Hunting horn has the Hunter's Call Special Rule.

wargear.name: Moonshadow bridle
wargear.summary: A silvered bridle from the Khan's favoured steed.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with the Moonshadow bridle has the Rider's Bond Special Rule.

rules.name: Storm Riders
rules.summary: Riders who burst out of the flank are already committed.
rules.text: A Unit composed entirely of Models with this Special Rule that arrives from Reserves may declare a Charge in the same Battle Turn it arrives.

rules.name: Khagan's Escort
rules.summary: The Khan's chosen ride where he rides.
rules.text: While a Unit with this Special Rule is within 12" of Jaghatai Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan, its Models add 1 to their Cool Checks and add 1 to the result of its Charge Rolls.

rules.name: Tempest-Born
rules.summary: Wind, dust and lightning gather round the Stormseers' brothers.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule against Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Killers in the Dark
rules.summary: The Dark Sons are in place before the enemy knows a fight has begun.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule has the Infiltrate (9) Special Rule. During the first Battle Turn, enemy Units cannot make Reaction Shooting Attacks against a Unit with this Special Rule.

rules.name: Rolling Thunder
rules.summary: The drum rolls, and the enemy hears the hooves before it sees them.
rules.text: When a Unit with this Special Rule makes a Charge, enemy Shooting Attacks made as Reactions against it subtract 1 from the result of their Hit Tests.

rules.name: Wind-Cloaked
rules.summary: Grey and white pinions flicker where the eye cannot settle.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule against Shooting Attacks made from more than 12" away.

rules.name: Sworn Knots
rules.summary: One knot cut, one vow kept, one breath of calm.
rules.text: Once per battle, a Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule automatically passes one Cool Check of the Controlling Player's choice.

rules.name: Null-Wind Ward
rules.summary: A carved ward that turns the Warp's breath aside.
rules.text: When an enemy Model makes a Psychic Check that targets a Unit including a Model with this Special Rule, it subtracts 1 from the result.

rules.name: Dust Cloud
rules.summary: The riders vanish in their own wake.
rules.text: After a Vehicle with this Special Rule Rushes, enemy Shooting Attacks that target it subtract 1 from the result of their Hit Tests until the start of its Controlling Player's next Battle Turn.

rules.name: Hunter's Call
rules.summary: One note from the horn, and the second wave is already falling.
rules.text: When a friendly Unit arrives from Reserves within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule, it adds 1 to the result of its Charge Roll in that Battle Turn.

rules.name: Warrior-Poet of Chogoris
rules.summary: He is the calm, courteous host who weighs a man before he kills him.
rules.text: This Model adds 1 to its Intelligence Characteristic and subtracts 1 from its Attacks Characteristic. Once per battle, at the start of a Challenge this Model is engaged in, the Controlling Player may declare Measured Words; the opposing Controlling Player subtracts 2 from every Focus Roll made in that Challenge.

rules.name: Rider of the Endless Steppe
rules.summary: He is born on horseback, and the horizon is an invitation.
rules.text: This Model adds 1 to its Initiative Characteristic and subtracts 1 from its Weapon Skill Characteristic. Its Controlling Player subtracts 1 from this Model's Focus Rolls in Challenges. Enemy Units cannot make Reaction Shooting Attacks against this Model's Unit in a Battle Turn in which it Rushed. After both sides have deployed and before the first Battle Turn begins, this Model's Unit may make a free Move of up to 8".

rules.name: Ghost of the Steppe
rules.summary: He is gone before the dust settles, and the foe is left holding the air.
rules.text: At the end of the Assault phase, if this Model's Unit won a Combat, that Unit may make a free Disengage move of up to 6". This Model subtracts 1 from its Wounds Characteristic.

rules.name: Rider's Bond
rules.summary: Horse and rider answer before the thought.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 2 to its Charge Rolls.

rules.name: Steppe Marksman
rules.summary: A hunter's eye, trained since before he could walk.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to the result of its Hit Tests made with ranged weapons against a target more than 12" away.

rules.name: Loosed at the Gallop
rules.summary: The riders of Chogoris shoot as they ride, never slowing to aim.
rules.text: A Unit made up of Models with this Special Rule may make a Shooting Attack in a Battle Turn in which it Rushed. Every attack made as part of that Shooting Attack is made as a Snap Shot.

rites.name: The Great Hunt
rites.flavor: The steppe has no fortresses. It has only prey that has not yet noticed it is being run down.
benefits: Outrider Squadrons, Scimitar Jetbike Squadrons and Golden Keshig may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Scimitar Jetbike Squadrons and Golden Keshig gain Outflank; Outrider Squadrons already have it.
Those units gain Storm Riders: a Unit entering from Reserves may still Charge in that Battle Turn.
limitations: At least two Outrider, Scimitar or Keshig units are required.
At least one unit with Storm Riders must start the battle in Reserves.
No Terminator squads, and no Armour, Heavy Transport or War Engine units.

modifiers.text: The Great Hunt: Line (1), Storm Riders.

require.note: Bring at least two cavalry squads.

rites.name: The Khagan's Own
rites.flavor: When the Khan's own riders and shadows take the line, the rest of the Legion simply follows.
benefits: Golden Keshig and Ebon Keshig may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Keshig gain Khagan's Escort: while within 12" of the Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan they add 1 to their Cool Checks and to their Charge Rolls.
limitations: The Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan must lead the army.
At least two Keshig units are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler, Breacher, Scout or Inductii Squads.

modifiers.text: The Khagan's Own: Line (1), Khagan's Escort.

require.note: The Khan, Qin Xa or Hibou Khan must lead the army.
Bring at least two Keshig units.

rites.name: Calling the Tempest
rites.flavor: The Stormseers raise their voices, and the sky answers in kind.
benefits: Falcon's Claws may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Stormseers and Falcon's Claws gain Tempest-Born: the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule against Shooting Attacks.
limitations: At least two Stormseers are required.
No Armour, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units.

rites.name: Dark Sons Descend
rites.flavor: No one remembers the Dark Sons' names. They like it that way, and so does the Khan.
benefits: Dark Sons of Death may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Dark Sons gain Killers in the Dark: Infiltrate (9), and enemy Units cannot make Reaction Shooting Attacks against them in the first Battle Turn.
limitations: At least two Dark Sons of Death squads are required.
No Stormseers or other models with the Psyker Trait.

modifiers.text: Dark Sons Descend: Line (1), Killers in the Dark, Infiltrate (9).

require.note: Bring at least two Dark Sons of Death squads.
